card.name: Digits inside zip codes and ISBNs
card.fires_on: A middle digit in a long number string such as a US zip code, ISBN or isotope number like I-131. Also the 'ol' inside ketorolac.

modes.label: Digits in codes
modes.description: A single digit partway through a zip code, ISBN, or wavelength or isotope number.

modes.label: Inside ketorolac
modes.description: The 'ol' piece in the middle of the drug name ketorolac.

card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle of a long number like a zip code or ISBN, and on the middle of the word ketorolac.
